description: Agent provides basic help but misses proactive solutions; customer left without full resolution

messages.content: I can't log into my account. I keep getting an error when I try to reset my password.
I'm sorry to hear that. What error message are you seeing when you try to reset your password?
It says 'Too many reset attempts. Account temporarily locked.' I've been locked out for 2 hours now.

Account locks from too many reset attempts typically expire after 30 minutes. Since it's been 2 hours, it should be unlocked by now. Please try the password reset again and let me know if you still see the error.
I just tried again and it's still showing the same locked message.

That's unusual. The lock should have expired by now. I'd suggest trying the following:
1. Clear your browser cache and cookies
2. Try using a different browser or incognito mode
3. If that doesn't work, you may need to wait a bit longer

If none of these work, you can contact our technical support team at support@example.com for further assistance.
